text:
```yaml
name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download

    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./...

    - name: Build binary
      run: go build -o gh-aw .

    - name: Test gh aw compile with default behavior
      run: ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions

    - name: Test gh aw compile with --no-instructions flag
      run: ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions

    - name: Test gh aw compile with --no-emit flag
      run: ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions --no-emit

    - name: Verify instruction files are created
      run: |
        if [ ! -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md ]; then
          echo "Instruction file not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        if [ ! -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md ]; then
          echo "Prompt file not found"
          exit 1
        fi
```
